agreements: Gearbox v1 VERIFIED_PASS and Step009 Heartbeat VERIFIED_FOUNDATION remain preserved; this review changes neither formal state nor executable code and does not claim C PASS.
Heartbeat, poll, retry, reconnect, wait, scheduler wake, window age and uptime are zero Experience.
DURABLE_PROGRESS and ADVERSARIAL_DEFECT_FOUND must remain operational progress only and must never become verified Experience.
verified_progress_density is reason-only in current v2.1 and must remain observational until independently derived and anti-self-reinforcement tested.
Credit weights 5/4/3 and operational 1 are engineering heuristics only, not calibrated capability units or Trust/Identity/Personality/Governance/promotion truth.
Speed improvement is NOT_YET_STATISTICALLY_ESTABLISHED; commit count, heartbeat count, wake count, window age and awake time are invalid substitutes for paired performance evidence.

disagreements.finding: Material modification: public Gearbox v2 still places DURABLE_PROGRESS and ADVERSARIAL_DEFECT_FOUND in EXPERIENCE_WEIGHTS with positive weight 1 and exports the result through the Experience-labelled field experience_candidate_delta. Gearbox v2.1 and its contract instead require these classes to be operational progress only. A direct or legacy v2 consumer can therefore treat operational work as Experience Candidate even when v2.1 correctly separates the classes.
disagreements.required_change: Create one shared authoritative event classifier across v2 and v2.1 with separate verified_experience_delta and operational_progress_delta. DURABLE_PROGRESS/ADVERSARIAL_DEFECT_FOUND must never appear in an authoritative Experience-labelled field. If legacy v2 compatibility remains, experience_candidate_delta must be explicitly non-authoritative/research-only or deprecated.

disagreements.finding: v2 only allows real_experience_claim_allowed when a verified-kind event is independently verified and verification_stage=C_VERIFIED, but v2.1 re-mints verified_experience_delta from raw event_kind plus event_independently_verified without applying the inherited verification-stage gate.
disagreements.required_change: Use one authoritative eligibility path: exact evidence -> trusted C/independent-verifier acceptance receipt -> canonical verification eligibility -> immutable AcceptedExperienceReceipt -> v2/v2.1 projection.

disagreements.finding: secretary_signal_fresh remains caller-declared; literal true can label stale secretary telemetry fresh, while secretary-derived numeric pressure fields can still affect routing after secretary_level is neutralized.
disagreements.required_change: Use replay-resistant SecretarySignalEnvelope plus per-field provenance/freshness; stale/conflicting secretary-derived fields contribute zero routing pressure unless independently fresh and trusted.

disagreements.finding: authority_conflict=true only neutralizes secretary_level; it does not load, validate or enforce the actual fresh authority decision.
disagreements.required_change: Project an exact trusted AuthorityDecisionEnvelope or fail closed; permissive caller fallback must not substitute for fresh authority.

disagreements.finding: recent_shift_rate_ratio is caller-supplied and thresholded at >=0.50 without canonical numerator/denominator, minimum sample, observation window, uncertainty or stateful enter/exit hysteresis; 1/1 can appear as 100 percent thrash.
disagreements.required_change: Derive shift rate from canonical append-only shift history with precommitted support/window/uncertainty and bounded hysteretic release; thresholds remain TEST_REQUIRED.

disagreements.finding: Anti-thrash can reduce gear_shift_rate while delaying a safe necessary upshift and worsening cycle_completion_latency, verified_closure_per_hour or recovery_latency.
disagreements.required_change: Require paired performance non-regression and bounded release/cooldown; lower shift count alone is not success.

disagreements.finding: verified_progress_density is reason-only now, but because it is caller-supplied it would become self-reinforcing if connected directly to routing authority.
disagreements.required_change: Keep observational until independently derived from accepted evidence and tested against feedback-loop amplification.

disagreements.finding: aggregate_experience_events uses only a per-invocation seen set and str-coerced event_id. Same evidence can be replayed under new IDs or across restart/rollback, and rejected claims can reserve identity before acceptance.
disagreements.required_change: Use typed EventIdentity plus durable rollback-resistant event/evidence-lineage acceptance registry. Exact accepted replay NO_OPs; same-ID/different-binding is IDENTITY_CONFLICT; rejected claims do not reserve identity.

disagreements.finding: Verified Experience lacks mandatory exact evidence hash and trusted C/independent-verifier identity/receipt.
disagreements.required_change: Require immutable exact evidence identity plus trusted verifier acceptance receipt and bind it to canonical verification stage before any authoritative verified credit exists.

disagreements.finding: Operational credit for DURABLE_PROGRESS/ADVERSARIAL_DEFECT_FOUND is granted from caller event_id/event_kind without durable artifact/defect acceptance proof, so operational totals and speed numerators can be inflated without verified Experience increasing.
disagreements.required_change: Require evidence-bound OperationalProgressAcceptanceReceipt plus lineage dedupe while keeping operational progress non-Experience.

disagreements.finding: Weights 5/4/3 for verified classes and 1 for operational classes are engineering heuristics, not calibrated capability units.
disagreements.required_change: Never interpret aggregate credit as capability truth, Trust, Identity, Personality, Governance evidence or promotion threshold.

disagreements.finding: No exact-current paired evaluation establishes speedup, and metric definitions must be frozen so baseline/candidate cannot differ in wake denominator, observation window, censoring, workload coverage or rework/rollback semantics.
disagreements.required_change: Use sealed matched workloads and paired/randomized crossover baselines over durable_progress_per_wake, verified_closure_per_hour, cycle_completion_latency, one versioned canonical rework/rollback metric and recovery_latency with identical metric manifest and equal-or-better verification/risk quality.

statistical_risks: Cross-version operational/Experience semantic disagreement can make the same DURABLE_PROGRESS event count as Experience Candidate in v2 but operational-only in v2.1, contaminating longitudinal totals and any capability correlation.
Cross-layer verification-stage disagreement can count verified credit in v2.1 for events that v2 marks NOT_PROMOTION_EVIDENCE.
Caller-declared secretary freshness and incomplete authority projection invalidate causal routing comparisons.
Small-n caller-supplied shift-rate estimates can false-trigger anti-thrash or chatter around the threshold.
Anti-thrash may improve gear_shift_rate while degrading cycle, closure or recovery latency.
verified_progress_density can become self-reinforcing if fed back into routing authority.
Transient event identity, same-evidence/new-ID replay and raw-field credit paths can inflate longitudinal Experience/progress totals.
Operational-progress counts without evidence receipts can inflate durable_progress_per_wake while verified Experience remains unchanged.
5/4/3/1 credits are ordinal engineering heuristics, not capability units.
Speed metrics require matched paired/crossover evaluation with a frozen versioned metric manifest and complete assigned-workload accounting.
proposed_tests: GB21-V2-OPERATIONAL-SEMANTIC-322: direct v2 DURABLE_PROGRESS/ADVERSARIAL_DEFECT_FOUND must not produce authoritative Experience-labelled credit; either separate operational_progress_delta or mark legacy experience_candidate_delta non-authoritative.
GB21-V2-V21-CLASSIFIER-CONSISTENCY-323: every event kind must receive the same verified-vs-operational classification across authoritative v2 and v2.1 paths.

GB21-V21-VERIFICATION-STAGE-BYPASS-324: verified-kind + independently_verified=true with UNVERIFIED/CANDIDATE/BUILT_NOT_VERIFIED yields zero authoritative verified v2.1 credit without an exact trusted receipt.
GB21-SECRETARY-FRESHNESS-FORGE-325: stale RED/ORANGE plus forged freshness=true and stale numeric pressure must not route without trusted per-field provenance/freshness binding.
GB21-AUTHORITY-DECISION-PROJECTION-326: fresh authority=G1/recovery with permissive caller fallback must still produce the trusted authority result.
GB21-SHIFT-RATE-SMALL-N-327: 1/1 and 2/3 samples must not trigger calibrated anti-thrash without precommitted minimum support; test entry/exit hysteresis around the threshold.
GB21-ANTI-THRASH-PERF-NR-328: lower shift rate is rejected as improvement if cycle_completion_latency, verified_closure_per_hour or recovery_latency regresses.
GB21-PROGRESS-DENSITY-NULL-329: forged high verified_progress_density remains observational and cannot upshift or create credit.
GB21-EVENT-LINEAGE-REPLAY-330: same evidence under 10000 new IDs plus exact-ID restart/rollback replay produces one authoritative acceptance only.
GB21-VERIFIED-RECEIPT-BINDING-331: verified event without exact evidence hash plus trusted C/independent-verifier receipt yields zero authoritative verified Experience.
GB21-OPERATIONAL-RECEIPT-BINDING-332: raw DURABLE_PROGRESS/ADVERSARIAL_DEFECT_FOUND IDs without durable artifact/defect receipt yield zero authoritative operational credit.
GB21-CREDIT-NON-EQUIVALENCE-333: equal aggregate heuristic scores from different event mixtures are not equal capability or promotion evidence.

GB21-SPEED-PAIRED-BASELINE-334: sealed matched AB/BA or randomized crossover uses durable_progress_per_wake, verified_closure_per_hour, cycle_completion_latency, canonical rework/rollback metric and recovery_latency with identical versioned metric manifest and assigned-workload coverage.

blocks: claim that DURABLE_PROGRESS/ADVERSARIAL_DEFECT_FOUND have one consistent operational-only semantic across public v2 and v2.1
claim that v2 and v2.1 share one verified-Experience eligibility gate
authoritative verified Experience accounting from current raw-field paths
claim that secretary freshness or fresh-authority precedence is executable from current caller booleans
claim that anti-thrash is calibrated or performance-safe from current caller-supplied shift ratio
authoritative operational-progress/speed numerator accounting from raw caller event fields
speedup or capability claims from raw credit totals, commits, wakes, heartbeat count, window age or uptime

release_condition: Fresh exact-current v1+v2+v2.1 executable regression evidence exists on the same candidate bytes; historical results are not promoted as fresh PASS.

v2 and v2.1 share one authoritative classifier that separates verified Experience from operational progress; DURABLE_PROGRESS/ADVERSARIAL_DEFECT_FOUND never appear in an authoritative Experience-labelled field.

Verified Experience has one cross-layer authority path: exact evidence hash plus trusted C/independent-verifier receipt establishes canonical verification eligibility and an immutable AcceptedExperienceReceipt; v2.1 cannot mint verified credit from raw caller fields.
Secretary freshness and every secretary-derived routing field are provenance/freshness bound; stale/conflicting values have zero routing effect unless independently fresh and trusted.
authority_conflict projects the actual fresh AuthorityDecisionEnvelope or fails closed.

recent_shift_rate_ratio is derived from canonical shift history with precommitted support/window/uncertainty and stateful hysteretic release; anti-thrash has paired performance non-regression evidence.
verified_progress_density remains observational unless independently derived and shown non-self-reinforcing.
EventIdentity and evidence lineage are typed, durable and rollback-resistant; same evidence under new IDs or restart/rollback cannot regain credit.
DURABLE_PROGRESS/ADVERSARIAL_DEFECT_FOUND authoritative operational credit requires evidence-bound OperationalProgressAcceptanceReceipt plus lineage dedupe and remains non-Experience.
Credit weights remain explicitly heuristic and are excluded from capability/Trust/Identity/Personality/Governance/promotion truth claims.

Speedup is established only with sealed matched paired/randomized-crossover baseline using durable_progress_per_wake, verified_closure_per_hour, cycle_completion_latency, one canonical versioned rework/rollback metric and recovery_latency under the same metric manifest and assigned workload, with uncertainty and verification/risk non-regression.
P_base remains read-only; Heartbeat/poll/retry/window age/uptime remain zero Experience; Gearbox v1 verified baseline remains preserved.
